example_en: The key variable may not exist after 2015
example_zh: 关键变量 2015 年后可能不再询问

example_en: Is there any policy shock I did not create myself?
example_zh: 有没有一个不是我自己造的政策冲击

example_en: Has this exact design already been published?
example_zh: 这个设计是不是已经有人发过了

example_en: Six weeks of cleaning before I know if it works
example_zh: 洗六周数据还不知道能不能用

example_en: Twenty papers by design, not by topic
example_zh: 按设计而不是按主题归类二十篇

example_en: Everyone estimates the average effect, nobody has the mechanism
example_zh: 都估了平均效应，没人做机制

example_en: Which of the three literatures am I talking to?
example_zh: 我到底在跟哪一支文献对话

example_en: Four batches of inspection, which date is the treatment date?
example_zh: 四批督察，哪一天算处理日

example_en: Never-inspected firms are not a valid counterfactual
example_zh: 从没被督察过的企业不是合格反事实

example_en: Anticipation, spillover, and selection on trends
example_zh: 预期效应、溢出效应、趋势上的选择

example_en: What would I expect to see if the effect were zero?
example_zh: 如果效应为零我该看到什么

example_en: Each check must name what it protects against
example_zh: 每个检验要说清它在防什么

example_en: Freeze the main specification before seeing outcomes
example_zh: 在看到结果前冻结主设定

example_en: The same variable name means different things in 2010 and 2018
example_zh: 同名变量 2010 与 2018 定义不同

example_en: One province is entirely missing in one year
example_zh: 某年某省整列缺失

action_zh: 跨库合并与 ID 匹配
example_en: The firm ID changes format after the 2013 revision
example_zh: 企业 ID 在 2013 年改版后格式变了

example_en: Ten thousand yuan versus yuan, household versus person
example_zh: 万元还是元，户还是人

example_en: Drop financial firms, drop ST firms, winsorise at one percent
example_zh: 剔金融业、剔 ST、百分之一缩尾

example_en: Is entry and exit informative or mechanical?
example_zh: 进出样本是信息还是机械的

example_en: Every exclusion needs a line and a count
example_zh: 每一次剔除都要有一行和一个计数

example_en: Store labels and value codes next to the data
example_zh: 把标签和取值码存在数据旁边

example_en: What is the minimal regression that answers the question?
example_zh: 回答问题最小的那个回归是什么

example_en: Firm FE or industry-by-year FE, and why
example_zh: 企业固定效应还是行业年固定效应，为什么

example_en: Treatment is assigned at the city level
example_zh: 处理在城市层面分配

example_en: Weak instruments, pre-trends, first-stage F
example_zh: 弱工具、预趋势、第一阶段 F

example_en: Split by ownership, not by whatever is available
example_zh: 按所有制分组而不是按有什么分什么

example_en: Eight subgroups, one significant
example_zh: 八个分组一个显著

example_en: Is the effect big relative to the mean?
example_zh: 相对均值这个效应算大吗

example_en: Mean, standard deviation, and the count of non-missing
example_zh: 均值、标准差、非缺失数

example_en: Coefficients above, standard errors below
example_zh: 系数在上标准误在下

example_en: Four columns, one per specification
example_zh: 四列，每列一个设定

example_en: Pre-period coefficients should be flat and near zero
example_zh: 事前系数应当平且近零

example_en: Twelve subgroups in one figure
example_zh: 十二个分组放一张图

example_en: Note below the table, significance levels declared
example_zh: 表注在下方，显著性水平要声明

example_en: Data, code, output, and the order they run in
example_zh: 数据、代码、输出及其运行顺序

example_en: The report is generated, never edited by hand
example_zh: 报告是生成的，不是手改的

example_en: One analysis, two outputs
example_zh: 一次分析两个输出

example_en: A stranger can rebuild every table in one command
example_zh: 陌生人一条命令重建所有表

example_en: One sentence on the question, one on the design, one on the result
example_zh: 一句问题一句设计一句结果

example_en: Hook, gap, design, result, contribution
example_zh: 钩子、缺口、设计、结果、贡献

example_en: State the assumption and its threat in one paragraph
example_zh: 一段话讲清假设与威胁

example_en: Separate the mechanism test from the main result
example_zh: 机制检验与主结果分开写

example_en: Name the limitation before the referee does
example_zh: 在审稿人之前说出局限

example_en: Every citation must be checked against the original
example_zh: 每条引用都要对回原文

example_en: Data availability, pre-registration, conflicts
example_zh: 数据可得性、预注册、利益冲突

example_en: Must do, arguable, or rejectable
example_zh: 必须做、可辩、可拒

example_en: Thank, then answer, then say where it changed
example_zh: 先谢，再答，再说改在哪

example_en: Quote the comment, then the answer
example_zh: 引用意见再写回答

example_en: Every changed sentence has a page number
example_zh: 每处修改都有页码
